title: Bag Charms and the Accessory Gifts Everyone Wants Right Now
label: Bag Charms
intro: Bag charms went from niche to everywhere in a year, and they make a perfect gift because they are nearly impossible to get wrong. Pair a beaded bow charm and a tiny plush with a cream crescent bag, a silk scarf for the strap and a pink heart coin purse, and a plain tote suddenly has a personality.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on a cream knit of a cream crescent bag with a beaded bow charm and a plush charm, a silk scarf, a gold keyring, a pink heart coin purse and tortoise sunglasses.
Detail of a cream crescent bag with a beaded bow charm, plush charm and silk scarf on a woman's shoulder in front of weathered red barn doors, pink glitter tumbler in hand.
